clips.name: Idle
clips.description: Relaxed breathing, small head movements, and subtle shoulder and hand motion.

clips.name: Wave
clips.description: Raises a hand beside his face, waves hello, then lowers it naturally.

clips.name: Walk
clips.description: A grounded alternating walk with opposite arm swings, ready for hand-target steering.

clips.name: Jog
clips.description: A quicker approach gait with bent elbows and higher steps; no horizontal root motion.

clips.name: Headpat
clips.description: Ducks for a headpat, does three exaggerated pleased head bobs, then stands tall again.

clips.name: Petting
clips.description: A deliberately silly head-scratch reaction: relaxed shoulders, a tilted head, and a contented sway.

clips.name: Curious
clips.description: Looks toward a hand and tips his head as if listening, then returns to neutral.

clips.name: Nod
clips.description: Two gentle acknowledgement nods with a slight chest follow-through.

clips.name: High five
clips.description: Offers a raised palm in front of his shoulder, holds it briefly, then lowers his arm.

clips.name: Beckon
clips.description: Bends a raised forearm toward himself twice in a friendly come-here gesture.

clips.name: Celebrate
clips.description: An energetic two-arm cheer with a small knee bounce and a proud head lift.

clips.name: Shrug
clips.description: Raises his shoulders and opens his hands in a playful what-was-that reaction.

clips.name: Startled
clips.description: A quick recoil with raised hands and bent knees, followed by a slower relaxed recovery.

clips.name: Drowsy
clips.description: Slow breathing and a gently bowed, bobbing head with relaxed arms.

skinRepair.description: Arm/torso influences separated using mesh surface distances.
